patch.description: Update the name of a Submittal Response for the specified Project

name.description: New display name for the submittal response. Required. Maximum 255 characters.

id.description: Unique identifier of this submittal response option, returned as a string. Use as the {id} path parameter to update the response via PATCH /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/submittal_responses/{id}.

name.description: Display label shown for this response in the submittal workflow (for example "Approved" or "Rejected"). For default responses this is the localized label; for custom responses it is the user-defined name. This is the value updated by the update endpoint.

considered.description: Underlying disposition category the response maps to, which drives submittal workflow behavior. Fixed when the response is created and cannot be changed.

403.description: User does not have permission to update Submittal Responses

code.description: HTTP status in screaming snake case (like BAD_REQUEST)

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"submittal_response\":{\"name\":\"Approved\"}}"
